question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Difference of the position values of the last two letters according to English alphabetic series is (6).

So,

 
• WDLF

• PKSM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c22fbf05ea66bfb89acbf780f4b74260f52c927d0fb7811b797df706c65079f5.png]
